examples.en: She completed a degree in pharmacy.

examples.en: The pharmacy staff are checking the inventory.

examples.en: The college will expand its pharmacy department.
Please ask at the pharmacy counter.
examples.ar: من فضلك اسأل عند شباك الصيدلية.

examples.en: The library has several pharmacy journals.
